study_role: Prospective engineering amendment after the v1.1 run stopped before reference-error computation.

amendment.changed_rule: A non-finite FI evaluation value is permitted only where the original locked R2/SNR support rules already make the pixel ineligible.
amendment.implementation: Abort if FI is non-finite at any R2/SNR-supported pixel. Otherwise replace missing FI values only at the immutable evaluator boundary with a finite sentinel that the locked eligibility mask excludes.

selection.rule: Reuse the eight ROIs locked in v1; v1 and v1.1 stopped before any reference-error computation.

claim_boundary: A pass establishes deterministic and bounded-latency production of the already-confirmed PSHG local-orientation endpoint on eight public unstained fields. The amendment repairs evaluation-only missing-reference handling outside locked acquisition support. It does not add independent biological or clinical evidence.
